english.title: Dealer made false record of information on sale / let of television set
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a television dealer, made a record of

(A)_[the sale of a television set by retail]_
(B)_[the letting of a television set on hire or hire-purchase]_
(C)_[an arrangement for a television set to be sold or let to a person by another television dealer]_

which you knew to be false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE INFORMATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(b)(ii) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 1967 and section14(1A) of Wireless Telegraphy Act 1949.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a tv dealer
made a record of sale of a tv set by retail
which you knew to be false in a material particular

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Time limit on prosecutions is 6 months from the date on which evidence sufficient to justify proceedings came to the prosecutors knowledge. Proceedings shall not be so taken more than 3 years after the commission of the offence (section 5(3) Wireless Telegraphy Act 1967)
